email.mailtrap_description: Send email through the Mailtrap API, or catch it in a Mailtrap sandbox inbox for testing. To send real email, the From address must belong to a sending domain verified in Mailtrap.
email.mail_mailtrap_api_token_help: Create one in Mailtrap under Settings → API Tokens. Give it access to your sending domain, or to the sandbox inbox when testing.
email.mail_mailtrap_mode_help: Send email delivers to your members. Sandbox delivers nothing to real recipients: every email lands in your Mailtrap test inbox, which suits staging and development forums.
email.mail_mailtrap_inbox_id_help: Only used in Sandbox mode. It is the number in the inbox's address, e.g. 1234567 in mailtrap.io/inboxes/1234567/messages.
email.mail_mailtrap_category_help: Optional. Tags each email so you can filter by it in Mailtrap's email logs and stats, e.g. the forum's name.

admin.pinned_help: Set in code by this forum's configuration, so it can't be changed here.
